scope: P3-WARN-30 intent design; no runtime change

global.rule: official events may contribute without event geometry

point.rule: event may contribute only when provider point filtering or machine-readable event geometry proves relevance

bbox.rule: event may contribute only when machine-readable geometry intersects requested bbox

dwd_target.current_problem: WarnWetter JSON exposes WarnCellID but current runtime emits geometry=null and discards point/bbox context
dwd_target.implementation_requirement: integrate official DWD CAP/status geometry with polygons and WarnCellID
dwd_target.point_behavior: filter by real event geometry or other machine-readable WarnCell mapping
dwd_target.bbox_behavior: filter by real event geometry intersection
dwd_target.global_behavior: official events may remain available even when polygon is unavailable
forbidden: invent static Germany bbox as event coverage

implementation_tasks: Keep weather.warning.official; add no public capability.
Keep DWD and NOAA/NWS candidate set unchanged.
Keep aggregate strategy and event_filter behavior.
Integrate official DWD CAP/status geometry for point/bbox relevance.
Exclude BBox events without geometry from spatial matches.
Add diagnostics for warning spatial evidence as needed for HA acceptance.
Keep runtime map and Consumer V1 mirror synchronized.
Add global, point, bbox, empty-feed, and missing-geometry tests.
Bump build/loader only because P3-WARN-40 is a real runtime change.
invariants: No new public capability is introduced.
Provider ID is not a scoring axis.
Official warning is not a thunderstorm cell, probability, or lightning observation.
Missing CAP fields are never invented.
Missing event geometry cannot prove point/bbox relevance.
Endpoint reachability is not coverage evidence.
Cross-provider deduplication is forbidden without a stable identity contract.
